facts.claim: Seven Seas Explorer (Regent Seven Seas Cruises): Entered service 2016; 55,254 GT; 750 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 224 m length; Explorer class.
Seven Seas Explorer is an Explorer-class cruise ship currently operated by Regent Seven Seas Cruises, a subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings.
